# Mixel apps

> Build focused audio tools that run on the person's computer: typed Python actions (`@ox.action`), an optional design-system page, published to a reviewed registry. Install the CLI with `uv tool install ox1audio`. Start with AGENTS.md; check every change with `mixel check`.

## Start
- [AGENTS.md](https://docs.0x1audio.com/agents.md): the whole contract for coding agents, under 2k tokens
- [First app](https://docs.0x1audio.com/start.md): mixel new, mixel dev, mixel publish

## Reference
- [app.json](https://docs.0x1audio.com/reference/app-json.md): every field and its rule
- [Errors](https://docs.0x1audio.com/errors.md): every code mixel, Mixel and the registry use, with its fix
- [CLI](https://docs.0x1audio.com/reference/cli.md): mixel commands and flags
- [Permissions](https://docs.0x1audio.com/reference/permissions.md): files, library, library-read, data, network

## Optional
- [Protocol](https://docs.0x1audio.com/reference/protocol.md): how Mixel talks to an app's Python
- MCP: `mixel mcp` runs a local MCP server with check, test, run and docs tools
